resources.string: See what works on this phone and report it
Takes about 1 minute. It doesn’t touch your other apps, doesn’t change settings and doesn’t use the network. Please stay on this page while it runs.
A task is running. Start the self-check after it finishes.
Report copied. Paste it into “Self-check report” on the page that opens.
The report only has the phone model, system version and the result of each check, with no accounts, app lists or your content. You can read it before posting.
Didn’t pass. See the report for details.
This system is older than Android 12, so phone control isn’t available. Chat, web and the sandbox still work.
This system has no Wireless debugging. You can start phone control from a computer over USB instead.
This environment can’t operate the apps on your phone (no Developer options or Wireless debugging); chat, web, files and calculations work as usual.
Accessibility is off. Turn on Mika’s accessibility in Settings › Phone control.
Accessibility is on but not running. Turn Mika’s accessibility off and on again in system settings.
Notifications are blocked, so you won’t see task progress or “needs you” alerts.
Battery use is restricted, so Mika may be stopped in the background. You can lift this in Recovery & repair.
The built-in helper isn’t running. Finish setup in Settings › Phone control, then run this again.
Mika’s virtual display couldn’t be created. Reconnect the helper and try again; if it still fails, please report it.
Mika’s virtual display has no focus of its own, so your screen may briefly lose input focus while Mika works. Everything still works.
A page didn’t open on Mika’s virtual display. Please report this.
System Settings opened on your screen instead of Mika’s virtual display. Please report this.
System Settings is open on your screen, so this step didn’t open it. Close it and run this again.
The page’s controls couldn’t be read. Turn Mika’s accessibility off and on again, then run this again.
The virtual display’s picture is all black or empty. Please report this.
Some actions didn’t take effect (see the report). Please report this.
The virtual display stops updating after a while, so tasks may get stuck. Please report this.
Your screen changed during the check. If you stayed on this page, please report this.
There’s no usable WebView on this system, so the built-in browser can’t work. Install or update the system WebView component.
The built-in browser couldn’t read or tap the local test page. Please report this.
The sandbox is only available on 64-bit ARM phones.
The sandbox isn’t prepared yet. It gets ready the first time a task uses it; then run this again.
The sandbox commands didn’t give the expected result. You can reset the environment in Files & computing environment and try again.
This check took too long. Run it again; if it keeps timing out, please report it.
This check ran into an error. Please report it.
The self-check ran out of time before this check.
This is Mika’s own test page. The compatibility self-check taps and types here; it doesn’t touch your other apps.
